fields.System.Title: RET-405 — Scrap with approval
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want scrapping to need approval and a reason, so that
stock is not destroyed on one person's say-so.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a scrap decision, then a reason code and supporting evidence are mandatory.
  • - Given a scrap above the configured value threshold, then supervisor approval is
  • required and the requester cannot approve it.
  • - Given approval, then stock moves to VIRT-LOSS with a scrap reason code, in one
  • transaction with the disposition record.
  • - Given the scrap, then returns.item_scrapped is published so the ERP can post the
  • write-off.
  • - Given scrap volume, then it is reportable by product, reason, and approver.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory, platform |
| Tables | disposition, stock_balance, stock_movement, outbox |
| Risks | Uncontrolled write-offs; scrap hiding a process problem ([doc 05 WF 13](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
